label: ESS Controller v16.5 - Dynamic Day
info:
TANDARRA ESS CONTROLLER v15
===========================
Victron ESS tariff controller for Contact Energy Good Nights
(free power Mon-Fri 21:00-24:00 NZ time).

ARCHITECTURE
  1. CORE CONTROL LOOP (60s)  - phase -> forecast adjust -> trajectory -> safety gate -> ESS writes
  2. LIVE INPUTS              - SoC, BMS CCL, grid power, AC load (real-dt integration)
  3. SOLAR PV                 - 5x MPPT power + daily yield aggregation
  4. FORECAST & SUN           - Open-Meteo POA model per array, sunrise/sunset (DST-safe)
  5. ENERGY & PERSISTENCE     - free-window accumulator, daily energy snapshot,
                                restart-safe reseed from retained MQTT
  6. SAFETY & OVERRIDES       - stale watchdog, startup hold, HA manual override

ALL tunable parameters live in ONE place: the CONFIG block inside
'Phase Logic + CONFIG' in the Core Control Loop group.

WHAT CHANGED IN v15
  - Export bands are now RELATIVE to the active daytime floor, not
    absolute SoC. The floor is dynamic (Forecast Adjuster can drop it
    to dynamicFloorMinAbs on high-forecast days) but the old bands were
    hardcoded at 90/85/82/80 - so whenever the floor fell below 80 the
    switch fell through to -150W and silently disabled export in the
    exact window the dynamic floor exists to create.
  - Band values raised: -9500 / -7000 / -5000 / -2000 (was -9500 /
    -5000 / -2000 / -500). At -7000W the pack moves ~0.5% SoC per 60s
    tick, so there is no overshoot risk against the floor.
  - NEW: PV full-export override. While PV exceeds pvFullExportOnW the
    setpoint is forced to exportBandFull regardless of band, because
    above that level surplus arrives faster than the lower bands can
    shed it and the excess just lands in the battery. Latching
    hysteresis (on 8kW / off 7kW) prevents setpoint chatter on
    partly-cloudy days. Published as state.pv.fullExportOverride.
  - The override only applies in EXPORT mode. Below the floor, climbing
    is the desired behaviour, and forcing full export there would pull
    the pack down through the floor to feed the grid.

MQTT TOPICS PUBLISHED (broker: HA Mosquitto 192.168.1.15)
  victron/ess/state            - full controller state (every 60s)
  victron/ess/routing          - PV/battery/grid routing breakdown (every 60s)
  victron/ess/free_charge_kwh  - Phase C import + $ saved (retained)
  victron/ess/energy_today     - daily accumulators snapshot (retained, used for reseed)
  victron/ess/battery_time     - time-to-empty / time-to-full (retained)
  victron/ess/sun              - sunrise/sunset/weekend cutoff (retained)
  victron/ess/status           - online/offline (LWT)

MQTT TOPICS SUBSCRIBED
  victron/override             - true/1/on = force NORMAL -150W (retained)
  victron/ess/energy_today     - self-subscription for restart reseed

NOTES
  - GSL battery manages charge AND discharge via CCL; CCL taper near 100%
    is normal (it also clips the MPPTs - cclA is published for graphing).
  - Grid import/export kWh are software-integrated from MultiPlus ActiveIn
    power with real time deltas (vebus energy counters unavailable).
  - Sunrise/sunset come from Open-Meteo with timezone=Pacific/Auckland;
    DST is handled automatically as long as the Cerbo is on NZ time.
  - Optional hardening: enable localfilesystem context in settings.js.
    The MQTT reseed already covers restarts without it.
